title: Implement the SSRF-safe destination resolver and connection policy
summary: Implemented a centralized versioned SSRF destination policy with canonical IDNA targets, strict A/AAAA special-purpose address classification, immutable approved destinations, pinned Host/SNI-preserving transport, per-hop redirect revalidation, redacted denial telemetry, malicious DNS/HTTP fixtures, direct-client architecture enforcement, and a validated protected-worker egress contract.

migrations: None; application/network configuration and code only, with no database or backfill impact.
decisions: Classify all A and AAAA answers as one strict set under a named IANA registry policy version.
Pin Net::HTTP to an approved address while preserving the canonical DNS hostname for Host, SNI and certificate verification.
Disable proxy routing and implicit retries and require a fresh destination decision for every redirect hop.
Retain only bounded address-family counts, port, policy version and allowlisted denial stages.
Treat protected-worker egress configuration as a deployment attestation backed by a default-deny infrastructure policy, never as the firewall itself.
risks: Deployment must implement and probe config/crawler_egress_policy.yml before setting the protected-worker attestation; browser subresource interception remains work for its dedicated later prompt.
next_steps: Prompt 069: implement the bounded HTTP fetcher and redirect handling on this approved destination boundary.
